name: Sydney
summary: Sydney combines spectacular nature – urban beaches, the harbor and nearby national parks – with a mature digital economy and good quality of life, but it is one of the most expensive cities in the southern hemisphere to live in. Accommodation takes up a large part of the budget, although in exchange the digital nomad finds first-class infrastructure, high security and a very active international community in coworkings in the CBD.
